defects.what: Both raised forearms end in one smooth fused lump with no hands and no fingers at all; the arms are also over-long and start wide of his shoulders.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw hiding the hands: 'ducking, both arms crossed over the top of his head, hands hidden behind his head', or crouching with the hands out of frame. Paste the 1762_manila string word for word (collarless baro, not a V-neck T-shirt) and keep the tattoo on the right forearm.

defects.where: whole frame, the hand behind the medallion
defects.what: The hand is one boneless mitten with a single crease and no countable fingers, the medallion floats in front of the palm instead of being held, and the skin is pale pink instead of Indio's warm brown.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw and choose: 'an old bronze medallion hanging from its worn cord against a dark background, glowing gold, no hand in the picture', or 'held by a brown-skinned thumb and index finger only, the other fingers curled out of focus'.

defects.where: both hands at the bilao rim, lower third
defects.what: Both hands on the tray are lumpy mittens: an egg-shaped thumb blob on the rim and fused fingers below, no countable digits, and they are grey-brown, a different colour from his face.
defects.fix_idea: Reframe so the tray sits on the bottom edge with the hands out of frame (raise y), or redraw 'holding the round bamboo tray from below, both hands hidden under it'.

defects.where: left hand and what it holds, left middle
defects.what: He holds a butter-knife handle while a woven straw ball hangs beside it with pale noodles growing out of it and a second brown handle stuck in its side; a stray fingertip pokes out over the top of his fist.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw without the risk: 'holding a plain fork with a few limp noodles on it, one hand, a thumb and four fingers', or put the hand out of frame and keep only his deadpan face.

defects.where: both hands on the phone, lower middle
defects.what: Fingers of both hands interlock across the face of the phone, point in different directions and cannot be counted, and neither thumb is readable. (The first reader's second claim is refuted: the camera lens is on the side facing us, so he is correctly looking at the screen.)
defects.fix_idea: Redraw and choose: 'holding the phone in one hand, screen facing him, only the back of the phone and his thumb visible', or reframe tighter on his face with the phone below the frame.

defects.what: The eyes are two blank white sickles with lashes and no iris or pupil at all, and the two differ in size and shape, so a held close-up of the lead reads as rolled-back white eyes rather than a downward glance.
defects.fix_idea: Fold into the same redraw: 'eyes half-lidded looking down at the screen, dark brown irises visible under the lids'.

defects.what: The hand under his chin is boneless: the top finger curls into a closed ring against the palm, the others melt into the fist and there is no thumb.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw hiding the hands: 'thinking, arms crossed, hands tucked under the arms', or 'looking up thoughtfully, hands out of frame'. Use the 1762_manila string (collarless baro, not a V-neck T-shirt).

defects.what: The big hand at his mouth has an index fingertip pushed inside the lower lip, three knobby stubs of uneven length below it, one bending backwards, no thumb anywhere, and stray scribble lines across the back of the hand.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw hiding the hands: 'whispering behind one cupped hand seen edge-on, fingers together', or keep the hand out of frame and tell it with the face alone.

defects.where: the writing hand, centre of the frame
defects.what: The hand holding the quill has only two digits: a thumb and one finger with a nail; the middle, ring and little fingers are missing and the rest of the hand is one smooth paddle that runs straight into the lace cuff. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Redraw and choose: 'a hand in a white lace cuff holding a quill, a thumb and four fingers, the little finger clearly separate', or reframe to show only the quill tip and the paper with the hand out of frame.

defects.where: both hands on the umbrella handle, left middle
defects.what: The upper hand's fingers fuse into one slab around the shaft and the lower hand is a featureless pale blob with no fingers at all, in a whiter skin tone than the hand above it.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw and choose: 'the red umbrella resting on her shoulder, one hand on the handle, a thumb and four fingers', or 'both hands in her coat pockets'.

defects.where: both eyes, upper half of the face
defects.what: The two eyes do not match: the viewer-left eye is smaller, tilted and set lower with its iris aimed down-left, the right is a larger round ball aimed forward, and both have grey-shaded whites, so the face reads as googly. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Redraw 'a terrified Spanish defender of 1762, both eyes the same shape and size, looking the same way', in the episode's anime style.

defects.what: Loose cannon barrels lie on the sea apart from the ships and fire from the water, and one cannon sits on top of a deck firing sideways. The still is also in a flat Western comic style, not the anime of the episode.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw: 'warships firing broadsides, smoke from the gun ports along the ship sides, no loose cannons, no cannons on the water', with the episode's anime style line pasted word for word.

defects.what: A cannon barrel grows out of the middle of the exploding wall and fires, and the wall is a crenellated European castle drawn in Western comic style.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw: 'a section of thick low Spanish bastion wall bursting from a cannonball hit, flying stones and dust, no cannon in the picture', in the episode's anime style.

defects.what: The intro Indio is a different person from the rest of the episode: sleek side-parted hair, an older narrow face, thin eyes, a white collared dress shirt (neither the baro nor the orange windbreaker), a plain medallion and no forearm tattoo.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw with the cast string pasted word for word (1762_manila or modern_rider_from_ep2) and keep the take closest to the face the episode settles on; this is the opening shot, so draw up to four and choose.

defects.where: the gear disc at top centre, right beside his head
defects.what: A human face is embossed on the gear behind his head with skewed eyes and a melting mouth, so a second, deformed face sits next to Indio's. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Fold into the same redraw: 'plain gear rims and plain clock faces, no portraits, no faces, no numerals, no letters'.

defects.what: The line on this shot is 'May pangalawa na akong tattoo sa braso' (I now have a second tattoo), but the arm carries only one small diamond tattoo. (Missed by the first reader; the fist itself is clean, a thumb and four fingers.)
defects.fix_idea: Redraw with two small indigo geometric tattoos on the forearm, the newer one glowing faint gold, the arm alone in frame.

defects.where: the clock rings, left and right of his head
defects.what: The rings behind him carry rows of letter-like glyphs: repeated E-shapes and Roman-numeral marks around the dials.
defects.fix_idea: Fold into the same redraw: 'plain gear rims, no numerals, no letters, no glyphs'.

defects.what: A different look from the majority of Indio shots: tousled brown-black spiky hair, a rounder face, bigger brown eyes and richer painterly shading; the broad band tattoo on the forearm also does not match the small wrist diamond of k39.
defects.fix_idea: Decide one Indio for the episode first, then redraw either this shot or the majority set to match. The hands on the tray here are the best in the episode and worth keeping as the reference pose.

defects.what: Same newer look as k00 (tousled brown-gold spiky hair with no topknot, rounder face, warmer render), so the cut from k45 to k47 changes his hair and face. Both fists are clean, a thumb and four fingers each.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw matched to whichever Indio the episode settles on, with the topknot the cast string asks for.

defects.what: His face here is rounder, the eyes bigger and browner and the skin warmer than in k03, k05, k07 and k08, so this shot sits between the two Indio looks rather than with the majority.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw with whichever look the episode settles on, cast string pasted word for word.

defects.what: Indio's eyes are steel grey-blue in k05, k07, k08, k30, k34 and k40 but warm brown in k00, k03, k09, k45 and k47, so his eye colour changes from shot to shot. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Add 'dark brown eyes' to the Indio cast string and use it in every redraw.

defects.what: In 1762 he wears a modern collared button-down shirt in k25 and k30 and a V-neck T-shirt in k12 and k34, where the cast string asks for a collarless baro.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw with the 1762_manila string word for word, adding 'collarless, no collar, no buttons'.

defects.what: The medallion face changes across shots: a sun with a triangle in k10, a star or flower in k00 and k47, and a plain blank disc in k01, k03, k05, k09 and k25.
defects.fix_idea: Add one fixed medallion description to the cast string (e.g. 'a round bronze medallion engraved with a sun and a triangle') and use it in every redraw.

defects.what: Unsure: the glove shows a thumb and three fingers, with the rightmost digit twice as wide as the others, as though the ring and little fingers were fused into one.
defects.fix_idea: Reframe, or redraw 'one gloved hand, a thumb and four fingers clearly separate, reaching into the chest of plain worn coins'.

defects.what: The 'full' stills are drawn in a thick-line Western comic style with flat poster colour, not the anime cel look of the character keys, so every cut from a character shot to one of them jolts. It is a pattern across k14, k18, k20, k24, k31 and k33.
defects.fix_idea: When any of these is redrawn, paste the episode's style line word for word and keep the same anime cel look; redo the rest in the same pass if the engine allows.

defects.what: Unsure: the extended digit is thick and nail-less and reads as a thumb, and only three curled knuckles sit below it, so the gesture reads as a sideways thumbs-up with a finger missing rather than the point the line asks for.
defects.fix_idea: Redraw and choose: 'pointing straight at the viewer with the index finger, thumb raised, three fingers curled'.

defects.where: the thumb and palm, left of the phone
defects.what: Unsure: the four fingers on the right are correct and have nails, but the thumb is an oversized column with no nail and no joint and the palm below it is a blank mass. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Redraw 'a brown hand holding a smartphone, a thumb with a nail and four fingers' if the shot is redone for any other reason.

defects.what: The basket of noodles floats in front of his chest with no hands holding it and the noodles are rubbery glowing loops.
defects.fix_idea: Reframe lower so the basket sits on the bottom edge, or redraw 'holding the bamboo tray with both hands hidden under it'.

defects.where: upper left sky; and all four edges
defects.what: A lone mast with its yard rises out of the treeline with no ship under it and reads as a giant cross in the sky; the picture also has a near-black border about 3 px wide on all four edges.
defects.fix_idea: Reframe (crop a few px in x and y) to drop the border. The mast is minor; remove it if the shot is redrawn.

defects.where: right of centre, among her hair strands below the umbrella
defects.what: A small bright yellow-green blob with jagged pixel edges sits between her hair strands, left over from the chroma-key cut-out. (The first reader placed it beside the umbrella tip; it is in the hair.)
defects.fix_idea: Clean the cut-out mask of chars/woman.jpg and recomposite. No redraw needed.

defects.what: The helmet carries a small square badge that reads as a brand logo and a faint numeral-like mark on the inner rim.
defects.fix_idea: Reframe so the helmet badge is out of frame, or accept as minor.

defects.what: The 1762 sepoy-turned-farmer wears a modern collared dress shirt with a patch breast pocket and plastic buttons. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Redraw 'wearing a loose plain collarless cotton camisa, no pocket, no buttons' if the shot is redone.

defects.what: Usman is missing: the intro prompt places the black street dog next to Indio in the opening card, and no dog is in the picture. (Missed by the first reader.)
defects.fix_idea: Fold into the k01 redraw: paste the usman string word for word and keep him at Indio's side.

defects.what: Unsure: the siege plate shown sharp is a semi-realistic painted render with photographic rubble, so the cut from the cel-shaded character shots (k12 to k13) may jolt.
defects.fix_idea: Leave if the conductor accepts this plate; otherwise blur it lightly as in the other siege shots.
